title: KBVE
description: KBVE Minecraft Server with a custom sky ship mod set in a survival eco-system. We are currently testing a new behavior tree mod and most of code is open source on GitHub.
body:
# KBVE MC

KBVE is a Minecraft survival server built around a living ecosystem and a custom sky ship system. Players gather resources, build, explore, and adapt to a world where AI and systems react dynamically. The project is open source and actively evolving with new behavior tree driven mechanics.
